mapper.select: SELECT id, menu_code, menu_name, menu_path, menu_icon, permission_id, sort_order, status FROM sys_menu WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.menu_code, m.menu_name, m.menu_path, m.menu_icon, m.permission_id, m.sort_order, m.status FROM sys_menu m LEFT JOIN sys_permission p ON m.permission_id = p.id LEFT JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE m.status = 1 AND ( m.permission_id IS NULL OR ( ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 1 AND r.status = 1 ) ) ORDER BY m.sort_order ASC, m.id ASC
